component.name: Hearth
component.summary: PipeWire mixer, mic routing and audio service control

description.p: Hearth is a control panel for a multi-bus PipeWire setup. It presents virtual output buses as a mixer, routes microphones to separate streaming and chat destinations, and shows the health of the systemd user services that keep the routing in place.
Hearth is built for people who run a Voicemeeter-style rig on Linux:

ul.li: Faders, mute and live level meters for each virtual bus
Per-application streams shown on the bus they are playing through
Microphone routing between stream and chat buses
Start, stop and restart of the audio services, with failure states surfaced
A debug snapshot command for reporting problems

description.p: It talks to PipeWire through its PulseAudio compatibility layer and to systemd through the user session, so it needs no daemon of its own.
Room-correction control, hardened single-instance messaging, and an argv-only subprocess layer.
